why_near_analytic: safety_proximity_harm is a DETERMINISTIC env-computed EMA of hazard proximity at the agent; its coupling to num_hazards is definitional. The driver's own docstring predicts 'safe(nh=0) ~0.0 vs unsafe(nh=8) ~0.87 BY CONSTRUCTION -> AUC ~0.95+'.

At num_hazards=0 the channel is IDENTICALLY 0.0 (mean 0, std 0, max 0, all 10 seeds). Since SAFE_GROUP contains that arm, every seed there has fire-rate 1.0 for ANY tau>0, so reachability >= 0.5 is guaranteed across the whole sweep -- the REACH_FLOOR=0.15 sub-condition is unfailable given a wired channel. Monotonicity then supplies the AUC sub-condition.
The criterion can only fail on a wiring defect, which is exactly what the driver says it is for (a flat signal self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a substrate verdict).

power_basis.formal_power_against_the_bar: AUC computed on n1=20 SAFE vs n2=20 UNSAFE per-seed scores (2 densities x 10 seeds). Null SE of a rank-biserial AUC = sqrt((n1+n2+1)/(12*n1*n2)) = sqrt(41/4800) = 0.0924. Observed best AUC 0.52 = +0.22 SE above chance; AUC_BAR 0.75 = +2.71 SE. By the null-SE approximation, ~77-80% power at alpha=0.05 two-sided to detect a bar-clearing effect. So the negative is REASONABLY POWERED against its own bar -- but only against that bar, and it would miss one ~20% of the time.
power_basis.same_run_internal_positive_control_STRON: The identical 7500 ticks, same 50 cells, same density manipulation drove the dedicated channel 0.000 -> 0.867 (density_spread_std 0.33112) while z_harm_a moved 0.441964 -> 0.441814 (density_spread_std 6.96e-05). The manipulation is demonstrably effective; the control's response is ~4760x smaller. This is a measured INVARIANCE, not an underpowered null.
power_basis.independent_reproduction: V3-EXQ-917's damage_sourced arm recorded 0.442/0.442/0.442/0.442/0.442 flat to the 3rd decimal, AUC pinned at 0.500 at all 18 thresholds (mech303_contextual_safety_threshold_reachability.md:122). 930 reproduces this on a different substrate commit. The frozen ledger question q086-zharma-calibration-vs-ecological has ALREADY adjudicated it (H-calibration-pathology confirmed, H-faithful-ecological eliminated, resolved 2026-08-02 off V3-EXQ-857a, lineage back to V3-EXQ-664). confounds: (i) NOT LOAD-BEARING BY THE RUN'S OWN DESIGN. combination_rule: C2 is a 'REPORTED control, NOT load-bearing ... a surprising C2 PASS is a context note, not a run failure.' A result the design declares non-load-bearing cannot be promoted to half of a headline dissociation by the self-route.

(ii) UNTRAINED AGENT, READOUT DOMINATED BY A PER-SEED INIT CONSTANT. No training loop anywhere in the driver. z_harm_a is an unconditional forward pass through a randomly-initialised encoder. Between-seed sd of cell means is 6.4e-2 at EVERY density while within-seed std is ~1e-3 -- the norm is pinned by a seed-dependent bias ~60x larger than any within-run modulation, and the global range 0.343-0.547 IS that init spread. An absolute-threshold sweep on an unnormalised norm cannot discriminate regardless of information content. That is a property of the READOUT, not of damage-sourcing.

(iii) z_harm_a DEMONSTRABLY RESPONDS TO DENSITY IN THIS VERY RUN -- the effect is swamped. Mean within-seed std rises monotonically 9.83e-04, 1.19e-03, 1.07e-03, 1.76e-03, 2.06e-03 (2.1x from nh=0 to nh=8). No per-seed-standardised statistic was computed and no per-tick series was recorded, so the STRONG form ('z_harm_a carries no context information') is NOT established -- only the weak form ('an absolute-threshold gate on the raw norm cannot use it').

(iv) NO MANIPULATION CHECK THAT THE DAMAGE PATHWAY WAS EXERCISED. Nothing records damage events, harm_obs_a magnitude, or heal dynamics; heal_rate=0.4 over 150 random-walk ticks may have generated little damage. The intended reading ('z_harm_a is spatially decoupled', which is SD-022's design intent and therefore the least surprising outcome) cannot be separated from 'the damage channel was barely driven'.

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: Contextual safety learning in mammals: IL required for safety EXPRESSION not acquisition (Kreutzmann 2020); vHipp->PL for safety-cue inhibition (Meyer 2019); standard safety signal -> vmPFC + hippocampus, dissociated from conditioned inhibitors -> dorsal striatum (Laing 2022). The signal-sourcing question maps onto the threat-imminence continuum: anticipatory EXTEROCEPTIVE distance-to-threat (PAG/hypothalamic/amygdalar) vs INTEROCEPTIVE tissue-damage afferents (spinothalamic -> insula/S1).
biological_reference.divergence: NONE -- this is a faithful translation, and that is the strongest positive finding of the autopsy. Brains do not compute 'this place is safe' from tissue-damage afferents. An agent that did would be unable to feel safe in an unfamiliar-but-benign environment and unable to feel unsafe while undamaged -- exactly the pathology V3-EXQ-917 measured (AUC 0.52) and 930 reproduces (AUC 0.52, spread 7e-05). The failure of the damage-sourced route is what biology PREDICTS, which vindicates the 2026-08-12 user-adjudicated routing (option (a) dedicated signal; option (b) threshold retune rejected).

A small, non-blocking /lit-pull opportunity -- nothing is gated on it, since the build already matches the biology. Recorded, not routed.

learning_extracted: A diagnostic can PASS non-degenerately on a criterion that is NEAR-UNFAILABLE given correct wiring. criteria_non_degenerate was honestly true and the PASS is honestly real; neither fact makes the result mechanism-evidence. The discriminator is not 'did the metric vary' but 'could this criterion have failed for any reason other than a wiring defect?' Here: no.

A claim_ids tag on a substrate-readiness validation is a ROUTING POINTER, not an evidence tag. The manifest self-stamped evidence_direction 'supports' for MECH-303 from a run in which MECH-303's gate was never enabled; left unadjudicated it would have entered the registry as a mechanism support.

A self-routed interpretation.label may assert MORE than the design's own combination_rule licenses. Here the label names a dissociation while the combination rule names one of its two halves an explicitly non-load-bearing reported control. Reading combination_rule against interpretation.label is a cheap, general check for this class.

An absolute-threshold criterion on an UNTRAINED encoder's norm is structurally unable to discriminate when the per-seed initialisation offset (6.4e-02) exceeds the within-run modulation (~1e-03) by ~60x -- while the modulation itself rises monotonically with the manipulation. Such a null is real about the READOUT and silent about the SIGNAL.

A control precondition can be trivially satisfiable: 'both_signals_apparatus_reachable' requires only z_harm_a > 1e-9 and finite, which a constant bias meets. 'The signal is reachable' is not 'the signal was exercised'; a pathway-exercise manipulation check is a different -- and here absent -- instrument.
